name: homestro_product_search
description: Search the Homestro Shopify catalog and return products with title, status, price, category, tags, variants, images, SEO and collections.

query.description: Shopify product search query. Leave empty to inspect recent products.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

name: homestro_price_check
description: Check Homestro product economics against the store rules: supplier cost up to 10 EUR, selling price at least 34.90 EUR, and price-to-cost ratio at least 3x.

name: homestro_create_draft
description: Create a new Shopify product directly in the connected Homestro store. Creates a German product draft with optional category, SEO, tags and initial price. Always DRAFT; never publishes it.

category_id.description: Shopify product taxonomy category ID, only when verified.

tags.description: German Shopify product tags. Comma-separated values are normalized.

price.description: Initial variant price, only when verified.

name: homestro_optimize_product
description: Fully optimize an existing Homestro Shopify product while keeping it DRAFT: German title and description, product type, verified Shopify category, SEO title/meta description, normalized tags, verified variant prices, collections, image URLs and German alt text. Never invent missing supplier data, never publish, and report warnings instead of guessing.

category_id.description: Verified Shopify product taxonomy category ID.
